summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Grupo Aeroportuario del Sureste (ASUR) reporting April 2026 passenger traffic across Mexico, Puerto Rico, and Colombia. No transaction, M&A, activist campaign, or corporate structure change is disclosed. The document solely provides operational metrics with year-on-year comparisons and Easter shift commentary. It is a routine monthly operational update, not a special situation event. As a foreign private issuer traffic release, it maps to a US equivalent earnings or operational update under Form 6-K. No deal terms apply.
